name: Everly for Vendors
description: Everly for Vendors lets wedding businesses on Everly run their whole Everly presence from Claude. Manage your listing (profile, packages, photos, visibility), work your inbox — read couple inquiries, reply, star, mark read, and move conversations through your pipeline stages — and let Everly's per-thread AI auto-reply handle first responses when you're shooting a wedding. The back office comes along too: create contract templates and send contracts (to Everly couples or anyone by email), issue and track invoices with installment schedules, record offline payments, keep a CRM task list, raise and track support escalations, invite teammates, and pull a revenue overview — all from a conversation with Claude. Requires an Everly vendor account that manages a listing. Claim your existing listing or create one at everly.so/for-vendors/get-started; the connector guides accounts without a listing there.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Everly for Vendors to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Everly for Vendors to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://vendors-mcp.everly.so/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Everly for Vendors MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Everly for Vendors lists 51 MCP tools, including vendor_contract_templates_archive, vendor_contract_templates_create, vendor_contract_templates_delete, vendor_contract_templates_list, vendor_contract_templates_update, vendor_contracts_couples, vendor_contracts_list, vendor_contracts_send, vendor_contracts_send_external, vendor_contracts_share_enable, vendor_contracts_share_get, and vendor_contracts_share_revoke.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Everly for Vendors?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Everly for Vendors in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Everly for Vendors MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Everly for Vendors requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Everly for Vendors is developed by Middle Lake, LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
